requirements.requirement: The system must include a numeric phase_score field in each clinical trial object returned by evaluate_care_facade.
The system must preserve the original phase value alongside the computed phase_score in the response.
The system must call the phase scoring logic from clinical_trials_service to compute phase_score for each trial.
The system must ensure the phase_score field conforms to the schema defined in clinical_trials_models.
The system must return phase_score as a normalized numeric value within the expected range defined by the mapping logic.
The system must include phase_score in all clinical trial responses passed through evaluate_care_facade without requiring additional client requests.
The system must not alter existing response fields or structure beyond adding the phase_score field.
The system must correctly map and include phase_score for all valid phase values (I, II, III, IV, N/A).
The system must assign a default phase_score value when the phase field is missing or null.
The system must assign a fallback phase_score when the phase value is outside the expected set.
The system must ensure that phase_score computation does not cause failure of the entire response if one trial has invalid phase data.
The system must maintain consistent ordering of trials before and after adding phase_score.
The system must ensure that downstream consumers of evaluate_care_facade can parse the response without schema validation errors after adding phase_score.
The system must produce deterministic phase_score values for identical phase inputs across requests.
